module.name: pdfonly
module.description: Content that appears only in the PDF: not shown on the slides (preview, slideshow, presenter, images, PowerPoint, video), printed when the deck is exported to PDF. For handout-only notes, such as where to find a video, a URL or QR code, or extra explanation. space: auto keeps a blank of the same size on the slides. Counterpart: @pdfhide.
module.aiSpec:
Wrap content meant for the PDF (a handout, a print) but NOT for the screen: where to find a video that plays on the slide, a URL or a QR code, a short written explanation that the speaker gives aloud. It is hidden everywhere else (editor preview, slideshow, presenter view, PNG / PowerPoint / video export) and printed when the deck is exported to PDF. Check it with Export PDF — the preview does not show it.
Parameters: space — none (default): takes no room on the slides. auto: the same room is kept, blank, on the slides (nothing shifts between the slides and the PDF).
<!-- @pdfonly --> The demonstration video is on Moodle (week 1). <!-- @end -->
The counterpart @pdfhide leaves content OUT of the PDF.

param.name: space
param.label: Space on the slides
param.desc: none = takes no room on the slides; auto = the same room is kept, blank.

snippet.label: Only in PDF
